items.title: Spider with a Paint Palette
items.alt: One spider balances a small palette beside its body and holds a short brush with one front leg, seven other legs easy to count.
items.description: One spider balances a small palette beside its body and holds a short brush with one front leg, seven other legs easy to count. Useful for personal art activity cards.

items.description: One spider holds a closed blank envelope with two raised front legs while six legs support it beneath. Useful for personal correspondence cards.
